archetypes.name: diag-parity
archetypes.rationale: Failure diagnostic source ordering spans review, implement, and collector paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed diagnostic resolution paths for ordering regressions. Focus on whether retry, NS-retry, sink, launch-stderr, and legacy sidecars are selected in the documented order without masking more specific failure evidence. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: probe-budgets
archetypes.rationale: Probe retry budgets must remain independent and preserve default latency.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Codex and Cursor probe loops for budget coupling mistakes. Verify timeout retries do not consume auth or transient retry budgets and that default timeout behavior remains one attempt. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: redaction-bounds
archetypes.rationale: This change touches secret redaction and bounded diagnostic reads.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the panel, voter, and parse-rate diagnostic changes for leakage and resource regressions. Confirm raw waterfall stderr is redacted before durable writes and that bounded prefix reads do not fall back to whole-file reads. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
